observations: Photo 0 shows a large black and white multifunctional copier with a paper tray on top and a control panel on the right side.
The machine has a white label with a color chart and text on the front, but the text is too small to read clearly.
The machine appears to be in a storage or sales area, with other similar machines visible in the background.
The machine is not in a clean or professional setting; it is on a concrete floor with some debris and a red cart nearby.
The machine has a visible power cord and a control panel with buttons and a small screen or display area.

claims.claim: A3 and a4 direct image multifunctional copier
claims.evidence: The machine appears to be a multifunctional copier, but there is no visible indication of A3 or A4 paper size or direct image capability. The label on the front is too small to read.

claims.claim: copy/print speed 28 copy/print speed. a4 colour...
claims.evidence: The speed claims are not visible in the photo. The machine's control panel or label does not show any speed specifications. The 'a4 colour' claim is not verifiable from the image.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, printing a test page, and copying a document.

risks.risk: The machine may not support A3 or A4 paper size or direct image printing as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the paper size selection menu or a test print of A3 or A4 paper.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not supporting A3/A4 or direct image

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden wear or damage to the internal components (e.g., drum, toner, fuser).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components or a video showing the machine in operation with a close-up of the drum and fuser.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown internal condition

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the door or on the back.
A clear photo of the control panel or label showing the model number and specifications.
A video showing the machine powering on and printing a test page.
A photo or video showing the paper size selection menu or a test print of A3 or A4 paper.
A close-up photo of the internal components or a video showing the machine in operation with a close-up of the drum and fuser.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
